name: v92_sga_actual_cost_surprise
hypothesis: Actual SG&A below analyst expectation can indicate near-term cost discipline and margin surprise without using EPS, sales delivery, buyback, option, or close/open timing.
expression: 0.38 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_sga_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_mean, 126), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_sga_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_mean, 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_sga_low) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Cost-delivery probe; distinct from prior SG&A estimate/guidance levels because actual cost beat is the parent.

name: v92_rd_actual_efficiency_surprise
hypothesis: Lower realized R&D expense versus analyst expectation may identify firms with controlled innovation spending and less margin pressure.
expression: 0.36 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_mean, 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_low) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_value / anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_mean, 63), 126), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Uses low-use R&D actual/estimate fields; reject quickly if LOW_SUB_UNIVERSE or if it maps to SG&A/accounting quality.

name: v92_sga_guidance_discipline_clean
hypothesis: Lower annual SG&A guidance with a narrow management range may capture cost discipline before it appears in ordinary profitability.
expression: 0.36 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sga_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sga_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sga_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sga_minguidance) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sga_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sga_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Annual guidance range has near-zero field crowding; no open-close or operating-income stabilizer.

name: v92_rd_guidance_margin_discipline
hypothesis: Lower annual R&D guidance and a narrowing guidance band may proxy for margin discipline among firms where R&D spending has become an overhang.
expression: 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_minguidance) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.12 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5))
notes: Tests the cost-discipline sign rather than the old positive R&D intensity sign.

name: v92_rd_guidance_innovation_confidence
hypothesis: For some firms, higher but tightly guided R&D can be interpreted as committed innovation investment rather than expense bloat; this is the sign ablation of v92 R&D guidance.
expression: 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_minguidance) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_rd_exp_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 63), 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.12 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Sign ablation; only keep if it is materially stronger and not a social/quality clone.

name: v92_total_assets_guidance_compact
hypothesis: Lower guided total assets with a narrow range can identify firms with restrained balance-sheet expansion, separate from 1QF net-debt expectation.
expression: 0.38 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_totassets_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_totassets_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_totassets_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_totassets_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta((anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_totassets_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_totassets_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 63), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Annual total-assets guidance fields are zero-use; strict corr check vs d5xK1kmg/wpR9AnYd/O0p8JGJq.

name: v92_total_assets_guidance_cost_combo
hypothesis: Combining compact guided asset base with low guided SG&A may capture capital discipline and cost discipline without ordinary value/quality anchors.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_totassets_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_totassets_maxguidance) / (2 * assets), 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sga_minguidance + anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_sga_maxguidance) / (2 * sales), 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_totassets_maxguidance - anl4_fs_guidances_advanced_af_nd_totassets_minguidance) / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Two zero-use guidance parents; reject if it simply becomes balance-sheet guidance capacity.

name: v92_ppe_asset_age_contrarian
hypothesis: Older depreciated fixed assets can be rewarded as a cash-harvesting asset base when not accompanied by high market risk; this tests the opposite sign of prior weak low-depreciation PP&E probes.
expression: 0.38 * group_rank(ts_rank(accumulated_depreciation_depletion_amortization_ppne / ppe_gross_value, 126), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ppe_gross_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Opposite sign from prior asset-age efficiency attempts; still expected to be risky.

name: v92_acquired_goodwill_lowcorr_rescue
hypothesis: Low acquired-goodwill burden had the cleanest current max-correlation among metric-passing non-ACTIVE alphas; add change and low-beta terms to lift Fitness without becoming a goodwill/social clone.
expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_acqgdwl / assets, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(fnd6_acqgdwl / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.12 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: One targeted rescue of d5xjqoMY-style low max-corr seed; do not expand if it maps to O0pNbJ17/MPpGzqwr.

name: v92_capitalized_software_burden
hypothesis: High capitalized software and long useful-life assumptions can represent aggressive capitalization; lower burden may identify cleaner expense recognition.
expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * capitalized_software_gross_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * max_software_useful_life, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
